refnamediv.refpurpose: Monitor Varlink socket traffic via BPF

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.VarlinkMonitor is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

The monitor observes Varlink traffic on the machine and streams it to the caller. Acquire() takes an array of MonitorFilter entries that are ORed together, where each entry ANDs its fields: uid (sender or peer user), pid (a ProcessId, i.e. a PID together with the pending pidfdId and bootId that disambiguate PID reuse), and path (socket path, with the empty string matching sockets without one). Without filters all traffic is captured. The reply carries a BPF ring buffer file descriptor, and the connection stays open until the client disconnects. Invalid filters are refused with BadFilter.

refsect1.title: Security
refsect1.para: The interface is served by systemd-varlink-monitord.socket, which starts one systemd-varlink-monitord@.service instance per connection, on the /run/systemd/io.systemd.VarlinkMonitor socket, which is world-connectable (SocketMode=0666). Since the capture is machine-wide and may contain sensitive payloads, Acquire() authenticates through polkit, selecting between the actions io.systemd.varlink-monitor.monitor and io.systemd.varlink-monitor.monitor-self, the latter for captures whose filters only match the caller's own user. The broker does not prompt interactively, so authorization has to be granted by policy.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# Monitor Varlink socket traffic via BPF. interface io.systemd.VarlinkMonitor
# An object for referencing UNIX processes type ProcessId( # Numeric UNIX PID value pid: int, # 64bit inode number of pidfd if known pidfdId: ?int, # Boot ID of the system the inode number belongs to bootId: ?string )
# A filter for matching varlink traffic. type MonitorFilter( # Match traffic where sender or peer has this UID. uid: ?int, # Match traffic where sender or peer has this PID. pid: ?ProcessId, # Match traffic on this socket path. Empty string matches sockets without a path. path: ?string )
# Start monitoring varlink traffic with the given filters. Returns a BPF ring buffer fd and keeps the connection open until the client disconnects. # [Supports 'more' flag] method Acquire( # Capture filters. Each filter's fields are ANDed; the array is ORed. If unset, captures all traffic. filters: ?[]MonitorFilter, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ( # File descriptor index for the BPF ring buffer. ringbufFileDescriptor: ?int )
# A filter parameter is invalid. error BadFilter( parameter: string )

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.VarlinkMonitor shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.VarlinkMonitor.Acquire '{}' invokes its Acquire() method.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.VarlinkMonitor interface was added in version 263.
Acquire(), BadFilter, MonitorFilter, and ProcessId were added in version 263.
